description_good_justification: README, first section: Matricxon is a self-hosted inference runtime for GGUF language models.
floss_license_osi_justification: The AGPL-3.0 license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).
sites_https_justification: GitHub and bytepenny.com are HTTPS only.
english_justification: All documentation and code are in English: https://bytepenny.com/docs/matricxon/overview/
repo_interim_justification: Every change is pushed to main between releases.
version_unique_justification: Each release has a unique tag (v1.1 to v2.1): https://github.com/bytepenny-ai/matricxon/tags
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known vulnerabilities (no CVEs or advisories) so far. If one is fixed, CHANGELOG.md marks it with Security and its CVE or advisory ID.
report_process_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md, "Reporting bugs and asking for features": https://github.com/bytepenny-ai/matricxon/issues
report_responses_justification: No bug reports have been received yet; reports are answered by the maintainer.
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement requests have been received yet; the issue tracker is open at https://github.com/bytepenny-ai/matricxon/issues.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability reports have been received in the last 6 months. SECURITY.md commits to confirming receipt within 3 business days.
build_justification: Python project: pip install -r requirements.txt. The optional native C kernels are built with the system C compiler (app/native).
build_floss_tools_justification: Python, pip, venv and gcc/clang are free software.
test_justification: Automated pytest suite of about 1,660 tests: https://github.com/bytepenny-ai/matricxon/tree/main/tests
test_most_justification: The tests cover the API routers, services, GGUF parsing and both quantized kernel backends (Numba and native C).
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: CI runs CodeQL on every push; the test suite runs locally before each push.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent changes add tests with the code, for example tests/integration/test_api_cluster.py.
warnings_justification: ruff lint (ruff check), configured in pyproject.toml.
warnings_fixed_justification: ruff check is clean on main.
warnings_strict_justification: ruff with the pycodestyle, pyflakes, bugbear, import and pyupgrade rule sets.
know_secure_design_justification: Admin calls are signed (HMAC-SHA256 with timestamp and nonce), API keys are compared as hashes in constant time, cluster calls are signed, and the prompt cache is encrypted with AES-256-GCM: https://bytepenny.com/security/
crypto_published_justification: Only published algorithms: SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256, AES-256-GCM.
crypto_call_justification: Uses Python's hashlib/hmac and the cryptography library; no custom cryptography.
crypto_working_justification: No broken algorithms are used for security.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: No SHA-1, MD5 or DES in security code.
crypto_pfs_justification: TLS is handled by the customer's reverse proxy, not by Matricxon.
crypto_password_storage_justification: Matricxon has no user passwords; it authenticates with API keys and an admin secret.
crypto_random_justification: Keys, nonces and tokens come from Python's secrets module and os.urandom.
delivery_mitm_justification: Delivered over HTTPS (GitHub) and git over SSH.
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hashes are fetched over plain HTTP; downloads use HTTPS.
no_leaked_credentials_justification: No credentials are in the repository or its history (checked 2026-11-05); .env is git-ignored.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL on every push and pull request: https://github.com/bytepenny-ai/matricxon/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Code scanning alerts are reviewed; confirmed issues were fixed on 2026-11-05.
static_analysis_often_justification: On every push and pull request, plus weekly.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The native C kernels are tested against the Python reference for every quant type (tests/unit/test_native_gemm.py), but not yet under a memory checker such as ASan.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No dynamic analysis is run yet.
